fields.rt-blog-html:
Today, social networks have become an indispensable tool for businesses, especially restaurants. 

Among the most popular social media, Facebook stands out as an effective way for restaurateurs to promote their establishments, attract new diners and interact with their existing clientele. It's not surprising when you consider that 72% of customers use Facebook to choose a restaurant, and 79% share photos of their meal. on Facebook.

In this guide, we'll explore the key steps to creating an optimized Facebook page for your restaurant, in order to maximize its online visibility and attract as many customers as possible!

‍

Why create a Facebook page?

Facebook pages for restaurants offer many advantages that can really boost your business.

Here are a few key reasons why it's so important to create a :

  • Visibility and notoriety: A well-managed Facebook page increases your restaurant's visibility to a wider audience. 
  • Customer interaction: The Facebook page offers a space to interact directly with customers. You can answer their questions, take their comments into account and manage reviews, which improves customer satisfaction and builds trust.
  • Promotions and special offers: Special promotions, discounts, special events... There are lots of things you can advertise on your Facebook page. This motivates diners to visit your restaurant and boosts sales.
  • Content sharing: Facebook lets you share regular updates on your menu, appetizing photos of your dishes, blog posts and more. This gets diners and prospects interested, and keeps them coming back for new offers.
  • Ad targeting: Facebook advertising offers precise targeting options, enabling you to reach your specific target audience based on location, interests, age and other relevant criteria.
  • Statistics and analytics: Facebook provides detailed analytical data on your page's performance. It's a great way to assess the effectiveness of your strategy and make improvements if necessary!
  • Influence of reviews: Reviews and recommendations on Facebook have a major impact on customer decisions. In fact, a well-managed page with positive reviews can encourage more people to choose your restaurant!

‍

6 steps to creating your restaurant's Facebook page

Here are the steps for creating your Facebook page!

Step 1: Setting up a professional Facebook page

The first step in creating a Facebook page for your restaurant is to make sure you have a business Facebook account. If you don't already have one, go to the Facebook home page and sign up as a business owner. Once you have a business account, you can start creating your restaurant page.

Step 2: Choosing the right category and name

When creating your page, it's important to choose the right category. You must choose the option: "create a page for a restaurant". 

👉 To find out more: How to choose the right name for your restaurant

Step 3: Create a captivating "About" section

The "About" section is the ideal place to present your restaurant in a convincing way. Describe the history of your establishment, your passion for food, the values you embody, and don't forget to include practical information such as opening hours, address, contact details and your online ordering site.

Step 4: Add a profile and cover photo

Photos play a crucial role in the appeal of your Facebook page. Choose a profile photo that represents the essence of your restaurant, like your restaurant logo. For the cover photo, opt for an image of your signature dish.

💡 For the profile photo, it's always best to put your restaurant's logo, with a dimension of 180 x 180 pixels. As for the cover photo, a large photo of your establishment (interior or exterior) is preferable. The ideal size for the cover photo is 851 x 315 pixels.

Step 5: Navigate the page tabs

Facebook offers several tabs that you can customize to present different aspects of your restaurant. Make sure you navigate through these tabs and fill them with relevant information, such as the menu, customer reviews and upcoming events.

Step 6: Understanding statistics and analysis

The social network also offers powerful analytical tools for business pages. Take the time to understand these statistics to assess your page's effectiveness and make improvements based on the data collected.

👉 To find out more, discover : How to advertise on Facebook for your restaurant?

‍

What information should a restaurant publish on its Facebook page?

When creating a Facebook page for your restaurant, it's essential to share relevant, engaging and attractive information to attract and retain your target audience.

Here's what visitors should be able to find on your page: 

  • Menu updates: share regular menu updates, highlighting new dishes, seasonal specialties or unique culinary creations. 
  • Food photos and videos: publish high-quality photos and videos of your most tempting dishes. Make them visually appealing by using appropriate lighting and highlighting details.
  • Promotions and special offers: announce special promotions, discounts, daily offers, fixed-price menus, etc. to encourage guests to visit your establishment.
  • Testimonials and customer reviews: share positive testimonials and satisfied customer reviews. This will reinforce your audience's trust in your restaurant and encourage other customers to leave their comments.‍
  • The team and behind the scenes: present your team in a warm way by sharing photos of staff in action or telling stories about the people who contribute to your restaurant experience.‍
  • Contests and games: run contests on your Facebook page to encourage engagement and offer attractive prizes to the winners.
  • Events: share the events you organize on your page
  • Call-to-action buttons : if you've set up online ordering (delivery and click & collect), display the "order" and "contact us" buttons.

👉 To find out more: 7 tips for collecting good customer reviews for your restaurant
